title: 计算折扣价格
problem_statement_md:
一家超市推出了一项活动，为3种商品提供15%的折扣。

编写一个程序，输入3种折扣商品的总价，并输出相关的折扣价。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]do-while[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A supermarket has launched a campaign offering a 15% discount on 3 items.
Write a program that takes the total price for every purchase as input and outputs the relevant discount.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
15000
4000
6700

[b]Sample Output[/b]
2250
600
1005

[b]Explanation[/b]
2250 represents a 15% discount for a 15000 purchase; 600 for 4000 and 1005 for 6700 accordingly.
[note]​ Use [b]cin[/b] inside the loop to the get an input for every iteration.[/note]
hint_md: 在循环中使用**cin**，为每次迭代获得一个输入。
